fields.why: Short-sleep prevalence is compared across 6 (middle school) and 5 reportable (high school) race/ethnicity groups and across 3 and 4 grades.

Race/ethnicity is clear; grade is recorded as age, a reasonable proxy since grades track age bands (the alternative would treat grade as non-SPD and drop age). Sex has 2 levels; states and districts are geography.
Methods state 'Pairwise differences ... among sex, grade, and race/ethnicity subgroups were determined using t-tests', and table notes mark significance against each group in turn.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether school grade counts as the age SPD.
